title: Page 102
transc:
DH Bates  Washn June 28th 1864 
Helen for Bellows tulip If you could put Lieut Paxton
Porter in charge talbot ordnance business talbot combined Persias it
would greatly facilitate the working talbot quotient here and would
also as I think be of great advantage to the
military operations yacht At present there is some confusion &
inefficiency in that branch talbot service shylock different pervues uper
rating against Horace stick I am expecting to start for
Snake every day but am detained by accumulated business Mars


10.30 AM DH Bates  Washn June 29th 1864 
Elizabeth to Belly tulip Meriden has applied for and
obtained leave to come to Hang for Consultation in
respect to future upper rations stick I have directed
him to whiff spring directly to you such spencer
as he may have stop I only know that
he has reached his supplies on Loup creek spit
Gauley welch Comet shall I forward letter from Wilmington
